headword: {主力商品|しゅりょくしょうひん}
reading: しゅりょくしょうひん
gloss: flagship product; main product; mainstay product

definitions.gloss: flagship product; main product; mainstay product
definitions.explanation: A company's central product line — the one that accounts for the largest share of sales, represents the brand, or drives profits. Often contrasted with supplementary or newly launched products.

examples.japanese: {我|わ}が{社|しゃ}の{主力商品|しゅりょくしょうひん}。
この{会社|かいしゃ}は{家電|かでん}を{主力商品|しゅりょくしょうひん}としている。
examples.english: This company's main products are home electronics.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}の{減少|げんしょう}を{受|う}けて、{会社|かいしゃ}は{主力商品|しゅりょくしょうひん}の{価格|かかく}を{見直|みなお}すことにした。
examples.english: In response to falling sales, the company decided to reconsider the price of its flagship product.

notes:
Composed of {主力|しゅりょく} (main strength, chief force) and {商品|しょうひん} (product, merchandise). Refers to the product that represents the core of a company's business — typically the best-seller, the one most associated with the brand, or the main driver of revenue.

USAGE:
- Frequently appears in business news, annual reports, and press releases.
- Often used with とする / としている: {家電|かでん}を{主力商品|しゅりょくしょうひん}としている (treats home electronics as its main product).
- Can also refer to a category of products, not just a single item: たとえば{自動車|じどうしゃ}{部品|ぶひん}が{主力商品|しゅりょくしょうひん}だ (auto parts are the main product line, for example).
- Contrasts with {新商品|しんしょうひん} (new product), {看板商品|かんばんしょうひん} (signature product), or {サブ商品|さぶしょうひん} (side product).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {主力商品|しゅりょくしょうひん}を{販売|はんばい}する: to sell the flagship product
- {主力商品|しゅりょくしょうひん}の{売上|うりあげ}: sales of the flagship product
- {主力商品|しゅりょくしょうひん}となる: to become the flagship product
- {主力商品|しゅりょくしょうひん}を{投入|とうにゅう}する: to launch the flagship product
- {会社|かいしゃ}の{主力商品|しゅりょくしょうひん}: the company's flagship product

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {看板商品|かんばんしょうひん}: signature/landmark product — the most famous product, emphasizing recognition
- {目玉商品|めだましょうひん}: loss-leader / featured item — the product highlighted in an ad or sale
- {新商品|しんしょうひん}: new product — recently released item
- {ヒット商品|ひっとしょうひん}: hit product — a commercial success
- {定番商品|ていばんしょうひん}: standard / staple product — a classic, stable seller
